method: Candidate sweep over flat/chop controls and rise/fall swings per mapped kind (rsi, cci, cmo, mfi). Crossings count bars with |display| >= threshold. Floors pin only the frozen threshold in tests/threshold_calibration.rs; every other number below is evidence, not code.

flat_40.verdict: quiet at the frozen threshold for every mapped kind

chop_40.verdict: quiet at the frozen threshold; fires at 50, which is why 50 cannot be trusted for alerts

rise_60.verdict: crosses at 100 for every mapped kind; sleeps at 2000

fall_60.verdict: crosses at 100 for every mapped kind; sleeps at 2000

floors.controls_at_100: 0 marks on flat and chop for every mapped kind
floors.windows_at_100: at least one mark on rise and fall for every mapped kind

gain_sweep.verdict: crossing counts are non-decreasing in gain on every fixture, so raising gain never removes a crossing
